Final categorization: EXCLUDED  
(Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that uses an agent-based model to simulate land transactions between farmers and nature-conservation organizations under global change scenarios. While it includes spatial modeling and future scenarios, its primary focus is on land acquisition dynamics for ecological network implementation—not on predicting or simulating land use/land cover (LULC) change per se. The study area is regional (Baakse Beek, ~300 km² in Gelderland province), not national-scale. Although the context involves the National Ecological Network (NEN) of the Netherlands, the actual modeling and results are confined to a local case study. Thus, it fails the core inclusion criterion of "explicit national-scale spatial implementation." Additionally, LULC prediction is not the central objective; rather, it is a contextual outcome of simulated land market behavior. Therefore, it meets exclusion criteria due to regional scale focus and lack of primary LULC prediction objective.)
